summary.plain: A United States Department of Energy multidisciplinary science laboratory near Chicago, one of the country's oldest national laboratories.
summary.technical: DOE Office of Science multiprogram national laboratory (Lemont, Illinois; southwest DuPage County), operated by UChicago Argonne LLC; chartered on 1 July 1946 as the lineal descendant of the wartime Metallurgical Laboratory.
